disposition: Working pin 44261eb5cf8275f132f63a3396903d116d701dbe is retained. Headless DES/ABM simulation, Arrow IPC/Parquet interop, C2 replay repeatability, and ED clinical dispatch pass 100% with zero drift. In accordance with spec.md line 22, no source pin changes occur in this planning revision; unverified hardware capabilities E6 (Metal/CUDA) and E8 (Multi-host transport) remain external dispatch gates for optional consumer tracks.

justification.headless_conformance: Working pin satisfies all consumer contracts with zero drift across 296 workspace tests and 969 Q/C flow tests.
justification.candidate_delta: Candidate 8282b1ab is 1 commit ahead of 44261eb, modifying only crates/kairo-ecs-gpu (adding numeric_batch.rs profiling oracle). Core scheduling, arrow-io, calibration, and ED logic are byte-identical.
justification.hardware_gate_isolation: Real Metal/CUDA GPU device execution and physical multi-host MPI transport remain unconfigured in the candidate; advancing the pin does not provide real hardware execution and would conflate headless readiness with hardware qualification.
justification.specification_conformance: Track spec.md line 22 explicitly stipulates: 'No source pin changes occur in this planning revision. R3 closes on an evidenced candidate decision and usable baseline, including an explicit retain-pin decision'.

missing_capabilities_and_external_gates.capability: Real GPU acceleration (Metal / CUDA kernel dispatch)
missing_capabilities_and_external_gates.resolution: Remains external dispatch gate for optional track E6. Headless simulation does not consume GPU.
Remains external dispatch gate for optional track E8. In-process thread emulator is insufficient for cluster gates.

supported_bounded_alternatives: Deterministic CPU-native DES/ABM simulation with stream/seed partitioning
Phased resource acquisition with automatic rollback on partial failure (AtomicMultiResource unsupported)
Sealed replay journals (kairos-c2-replay-journal-v1) with fail-closed sentinel collision rejection
Official Arrow IPC streams and Parquet physical reader/writers with schema limit guards
